system.longDesc: Also known as loading mechs, these are common industrial mechs used to haul large amounts of cargo with their claws and magnetic clamps, especially in standardized cargo containers. At large spaceports, one can see literal swarms of loader mechs and drones unloading cargo from ships, often in automated mode. Unlike construction mechs and salvage mechs, loaders are not enclosed, so when operating in a vacuum, their drivers must strap in while wearing a separate environment suit. Loader mechs are commonly available for rent at most spaceports.
